location_exception_reason: Storage Buildings are industrial infrastructure assets sold on technical specifications (span, height, load capacity, insulation, IS code compliance), not geographic origin. Location of the seller's factory or project site does not change the product's utility or buyer decision criteria. Buyers source from PAN-India manufacturers based on project requirements and execution capability, not origin.
biz_exception_reason: Business-type words ('Manufacturer', 'Supplier', 'Contractor', 'Service Provider') in Storage Building titles are redundant — IndiaMART's seller-type filter already exposes this information independently. Removing 'Manufacturer' from 'PEB Warehouse Shed Manufacturer' leaves a complete, accurate product title; the business relationship does not define what is being sold.
